tool_args.rationale: The pilot shows opposing step responses but leaves their fine-time evolution unidentified. A trajectory batch can distinguish competing transient mechanisms before fitting and forecasting.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a stationary hysteresis or relaxation model from the pilot
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five observations, including one unchanged-input control, do not identify the transient shape or its horizon dependence sufficiently for confirmation.
The opposing step shifts and unchanged-input control do not establish either supplied single-mode law as the complete mechanism.
It does not resolve the temporal mechanism.
